Class Map

java.lang.Object
domain.Map
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Map extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a map with a name, dimensions (width and height), and a list of associated scenarios. This class provides methods to access and manipulate the map's properties and scenarios.

  • Constructor Details

    • Map

      public Map(String name, int width, int height, int cellSizeKm)
      Constructs a new Map instance with the specified name, width, and height.

      This constructor initializes the map's attributes, including its name, dimensions, and an empty list of scenarios. It also validates the name and cellSizeKm of the map during initialization.

      Parameters:
      name - The name of the map. Must not be null or empty.
      width - The width of the map. Must be a positive integer.
      height - The height of the map. Must be a positive integer.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name is null or empty, or if the width or height is non-positive.

    • validateCellSize

      public void validateCellSize(int cellSizeKm)
      Validates the cellSizeKm of the map in kilometers. This method ensures that the provided map cellSizeKm is a positive value. If the cellSizeKm is less than or equal to 0, an IllegalArgumentException is thrown to enforce validity.
      Parameters:
      cellSizeKm - The cellSizeKm of the map in kilometers to be validated. Must be a positive integer.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the cellSizeKm is less than or equal to 0.
